_comment: Variant registry for the v9 'combined' experiment family (the original v8-prompt v9 run PLUS the starfish-camouflage-prompt v9_starfish run). Consumed by imggen/train/v9_combined.py and imggen/eval/v9_combined_on_duo.py, which were previously four copy-pasted scripts each differing only in these values. All four share the heavy-augmentation regime established by imggen/train/v9_duo_v3.py.
